preprocessing: the specs are formatted with prettier `semi: false`; spec_to_workflow splits statements on ';' only, so an equivalent semicolon-terminated copy was converted.

cypress_assertion_stats.py masks string literals by quote character, and the apostrophe in the regular expression /You don't have permissions to do that/i swallowed four of the eight permission tests; the assertion statistics were recomputed on a copy with that message reworded.
conversion.assertions_policy: every assertion is dropped by design; the counts above are the record

excluded_official_tests.test_name: should finish reloading the preview after a remote document update
excluded_official_tests.reason: document-detail/document-detail.spec.ts:91 has no UI operation after the initial goto: it drives the Angular component through page.evaluate(ng.getComponent(...)) and counts network requests; neither has a schema equivalent.

document-detail/document-detail.spec.ts:62 drives page.setViewportSize(400) and the Preview tab only exists below the mobile breakpoint; the workflow schema has no viewport action (stage1_record/workflow.py:77 PrimitiveAction).

source.test_name: should show a list of notes

statements.source: await expect( await page.getByRole('button', { name: /delete note/i, includeHidden: true, }) ).toHaveCount(4)

modifications: filter dropdown toggles -> css 'pngx-filter-editor button#dropdown_<field>': the same ids also exist inside pngx-bulk-editor, so the component scope is required.
dropdown entries -> css 'button[role=menuitem]' scoped to the open menu and filtered by text, because their accessible name carries the document count ('Inbox8').
the Document type dropdown entry ('Invoice Test') was missing from the mechanical output (the source used a /^Invoice Test/ regular-expression name) and was re-inserted.
getByTitle('Correspondent').getByText('Exclude') -> css 'label[for="intersectionExclude_correspondent"]'.
getByRole('button', {name:'2 selected', exact:true}) -> the correspondent dropdown toggle, which is the same control; its label is state-dependent.
getByRole('main').getByRole('combobox') -> css 'pngx-filter-editor .input-group-sm input.form-control-sm'; the source locator has no literal accessible name.
the text-filter mode toggle is addressed by structure rather than by its label, because the label changes with the selected mode.
page.locator('select').selectOption(...) -> css 'pngx-filter-editor .input-group-sm select.form-select' (four select_option steps kept).
the relative-date ng-select is addressed as css 'ng-select[name=createdRelativeDate]' scoped to the open dates menu.

DROPPED 4 operations: getByRole('menuitem',{name:'Relative dates'}).locator('span').first() and the two getByLabel('Dates selected').locator('button').first() clears have no schema-expressible unique locator; the created-from date typed afterwards reaches the same filter state.
the created-from date input is addressed with Playwright's :has() CSS extension, because four identical mm/dd/yyyy inputs exist in the dropdown.

the sort menu lives in pngx-page-header, not in pngx-filter-editor; every entry is a role button with an exact accessible name scoped to the open page-header menu (several filter toggles carry the same words).
the trailing '.w-100 > label > i-bs' click -> css 'label[for="listSortReverseFalse"]'.
'.btn-group > label'.first() / 'label:nth-child(4)' / 'label:nth-child(6)' -> the three stable ids label[for=displayModeDetails|displayModeSmall|displayModeLarge].
an explicit switch to the small-card display mode was prepended: the source relies on the display mode persisted by the previous test in the same file, which our per-case reset removes.

the shift-click range selection (.nth(0) then .nth(3) with modifiers:['Shift']) -> two plain clicks on cards 1 and 2 and, after the Page/All/None round trip, two plain clicks on cards 3 and 4: the schema has no click modifiers and no .nth(); the resulting selection size is the same but the operation count differs.
Page / All / None -> css 'pngx-page-header .btn-group-sm button' filtered by text.
